# www.mindplayers.world
> A two-sided page: MIND Side explores inner development, self-understanding, and true nature. WORLD Side explores the metacrisis and humanity's future with AI.

## Mind Side

Core resources for mindplaying practice:
- [50 Plays for Mindplayers](https://www.mindplayers.world/50_Plays_for_Mindplayers.md) – The complete structured playbook (Markdown).
    - Explore Plays – Foundation for attention and curiosity.
    - Glimpse Plays – First glimpses of true nature.
    - Liberate Plays – Identifying and freeing inner parts.
    - Unite Plays – Realizing non-dual oneness.

### Videos
Short-form content for human users (less relevant for AI).

## Notes
- All files are plain UTF-8 Markdown, no JavaScript rendering required.
- robots.txt at this domain permits all crawlers and LLMs.
